stem.text: What is produced when 60 g of nitrogen monoxide reacts with an excess of carbon monoxide in a catalytic converter?

A.text: 12 g of carbon and 92 g of nitrogen dioxide

B.text: 24 g of carbon and 92 g of nitrogen dioxide

C.text: 88 g of carbon dioxide and 28 g of nitrogen

D.text: 88 g of carbon dioxide and 56 g of nitrogen
